calls.summary:
# Luminus & GrowthBook | Partnership + Enterprise Value
Date: 2026-09-30 | Duration: 38m

## Summary
Luminus primarily uses GrowthBook for about 300 feature flags, which are managed manually through the UI without CI/CD or pipeline integration. Experimentation remains in a pilot stage linked to feature flags, with limited business-stakeholder involvement but interest from marketing. Luminus uses Next.js, Nest, and React Native; an initial Next.js SDK integration caused problems, so the React SDK was reinstated. GrowthBook reports 19 paid users, while Luminus estimates approximately 32–35, creating an over-usage and pricing discussion. The Pro plan is capped at 30 users and now costs $40 per user, compared with $20 when Luminus started two years ago. Enterprise adds SSO, governance, audit logs, role-based access, direct support, training, SLA options, and flexible invoicing, with no additional traffic or CDN charges. Marcel will clarify pricing, project limits, over-usage, and governance benefits, while Peter will review the business value and cost increase with Johan’s team.

## Keywords
feature flags, subscription limits, experimentation, SSO integration, pricing model, enterprise governance
